enemies.description: Row 1 sword strike: draw sword back, wind up, high anticipation, forward slash contact, follow-through, recover. Row 2 guarded cleave: crouch behind shield and brace, raise sword, strongest overhead windup, broad powerful slash with short ivory sword trail, follow-through, recover. Row 3 reverse return sweep: sword starts across body after first cleave, pull to opposite side, counter-windup, distinct backhand slash contact, follow-through, recover. Row 4 death: knees buckle, sink, fall sideways, land, settle, prone complete armored remains with sword and shield.

enemies.description: Preserve hood, robes, ornate trims and anatomy but replace fire with small violet magic in actions. Row 1 Soul Bolt: cupped hand gathers violet orb, raise arm, arm drawn back, push palm to release small violet bolt, recoil, recover. Row 2 Mending Litany: lift both arms slowly, raise arms overhead, teal healing light gathers, open arms releasing tiny teal wisps, lower arms, recover. Row 3 Quieting Chorus: hands at chest, spread both arms wide, lean back and lift hood, thrust both arms outward with short violet wisps, follow through, recover. Row 4 death: knees give, hood bows, body falls, robes slump on floor, settle, final crumpled cloth corpse.
